mdj7dcnq.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Pallazo Pine Cone Tree - Dual Colour LED
mdj7dcnq.sourceDescription: Palazzo Pine Cone Tree The Ultimate Commercial-Grade Tree for Fast, Stylish Installations Introducing the Palazzo Pine Cone Tree, a game-changing solution for professional festive displays. Built around a durable steel cone frame instead of a traditional centre pole, this tree is designed for rapid, hassle-free setup, making it ideal for commercial environments where time and efficiency matter. Featuring the same lush, full PVC foliage as our premium Ironwood range, the Palazzo Pine delivers a rich, high-end appearance in a sleek, space-saving profile just 110cm wide on the 10ft model. Its clever frame structure means the tree can be fully decorated off-site and then quickly installed on location, saving hours of setup time. The tree comes in three sections: the top half is a single piece, while the bottom half splits into two sections. For convenient storage, the top section fits neatly inside the bottom sections, reducing the amount of space required in transit or storage. Pre-lit with IP65-rated commercial-grade rubber cable LED lights, the tree is built to last. The dual-colour LEDs allow you to switch between warm white and bright white lighting by simply unplugging, rotating the connector 180 degrees, and plugging it back in no tools or programming required. Designed for indoor use, the Palazzo Pine Cone Tree is perfect for shopping centres, hotels, offices, and event spaces needing a reliable, professional-grade tree with stunning visual impact and minimal fuss. Fast to install, built to impress the Palazzo Pine is commercial decorating made effortless. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. ej0eet63.variantName: Walplus 100 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
ej0eet63.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of the holiday season into your home with this Artificial Christmas Tree, designed in the classic Art Deco style. This cone-shaped decorative piece is perfect for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, offering a vibrant green tone with a luxuriant appearance. The tree's 8 LED flash modes bring warmth and festivity, thanks to the integrated decorative string lights and USB power source that make it both stylish and easy to operate. A lovely addition to your holiday décor, evoking the timeless charm of Christmas. Premium Materials: Crafted from durable PVC and sturdy iron, this artificial tree promises longevity and resilience, standing strong and vibrant throughout the holiday season. The PVC material ensures a lush and realistic foliage appearance, while the iron frame supports and stabilizes its structure, making it a dependable centerpiece for seasonal celebrations. Illuminated Charm: Fitted with warm white LED lights and decorative strings, the tree creates an inviting glow. These energy-efficient lights are evenly spaced, offering consistent illumination and setting a serene holiday mood across any room. Conveniently controlled via USB, altering lighting patterns is effortlessly achieved to enhance different times of day or moods. Collapsible Design: Its innovative, fully collapsible construction facilitates painless assembly and disassembly. Approach storage with ease; once the festivities conclude, the tree neatly folds up, making it practical for those with limited storage space. Stylish Features: Inspired by the opulence of Art Deco, this tree's design adds grandeur to its surroundings, lending an air of sophistication. This striking piece allows you to embellish with ribbons and ornaments, inviting your creativity each year. Care Instructions: Maintain its sheen by wiping with a dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals to preserve its elegant matte finish. Such simple care guarantees that it maintains its brilliance and grace year after year, prolonging joy and holiday tradition. The lamps are not replaceable. If product is used outdoors, the USB should be plugged in indoors, in dry environment. This item is not a toy and should be used for decorative purposes only. The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Please note to use only certified DC 5V input. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fire. The flexible cable of the string light cannot be replaced, and do not use the string light if the cable is damaged.Do not connect the LED lamp to the certified 5V USB power source while installing and maintaining. This appliance must not be used by children under 14 years and persons with reduced physical, sensory or mental capabilities or lack of experience and knowledge concerning the use of electronic appliances. Do not operate this product near explosives or flammable liquids, gases and dust. Do not operate the product in the extreme temperatures. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

The layered design provides plenty of texture and depth, making it an eye-catching addition to your seasonal decorations. Ideal for displaying on front doors, internal doors, walls, porches, hallways or above fireplaces and mantelpieces, the wreath can be easily incorporated into a variety of home settings. Its artificial construction means no watering or ongoing maintenance is required, and it can be carefully stored away after use ready for future seasonal displays. Suitable for decorative use, the wreath provides a simple way to update your home throughout the season and can be displayed on its own or coordinated with other seasonal decorations.
